svg.text: Standards-Citation Benchmark for LLM Financial Auditing — dataset anatomy (Apple Inc., FY2023)
Thesis: LLMs can’t cite the governing ASC standard for a violation — even though it’s deterministic in the US-GAAP taxonomy. We measure that gap.
A record = one clean statement + one injected error
Rule’s ASC IS in the concept’s real
Governing standard the linkbase does NOT
tag on the line (e.g. AR→310 not 210,
also OK if in concept’s valid linkbase set
Citation EM — same benchmark, two systems:
Provenance: values = SEC EDGAR companyfacts (real BS+IS+CF) · citations = official US-GAAP 2023 linkbase (sha256 b48fbb7b…, 17,800 concepts) · transactions = synthetic (sum to real lines)
AuditBench: has a citation task but broken GT (GPT-4 prose, 26%, unreleased retriever) — not XBRL, not deterministic.
FinAuditing: real XBRL + DQC, but tasks are concept-ID / relation-type / value-recompute — NO citation output.
AuditFlow: deterministic taxonomy+XBRL verification, but outputs a numeric verdict — citation is never scored.
→ First benchmark to score GOVERNING-ASC citation on real filings with deterministic, cross-checkable ground truth.
